prompt: What is the expense ratio of SBI Bluechip Fund?
completion: SBI Bluechip Fund Regular Plan TER is ~1.59% p.a. Direct Plan TER is ~0.84% p.a. Source: https://www.sbimf.com/en-us/sbi-bluechip-fund

prompt: What is the TER of SBI Flexicap Fund?
completion: SBI Flexicap Fund Regular Plan TER is ~1.69% p.a. Direct Plan TER is ~0.94% p.a. Source: https://www.sbimf.com/en-us/sbi-flexicap-fund

prompt: What is the expense ratio of SBI ELSS?
completion: SBI Long Term Equity Fund Regular Plan TER is ~1.72% p.a. Direct Plan TER is ~0.87% p.a. Source: https://www.sbimf.com/en-us/sbi-long-term-equity-fund

prompt: What is the exit load of SBI Bluechip Fund?
completion: SBI Bluechip Fund charges 1% exit load if redeemed within 12 months. No exit load after 12 months. Source: https://www.sbimf.com/en-us/sbi-bluechip-fund

prompt: What is the exit load of SBI Flexicap Fund?
completion: SBI Flexicap Fund charges 0.5% exit load if redeemed within 30 days. No exit load after 30 days. Source: https://www.sbimf.com/en-us/sbi-flexicap-fund

prompt: Does SBI ELSS have an exit load?
completion: SBI ELSS has a mandatory 3-year lock-in. After lock-in, there is no exit load. Source: https://www.sbimf.com/en-us/sbi-long-term-equity-fund

prompt: What is the lock-in period of ELSS?
completion: ELSS has a mandatory 3-year lock-in as per Section 80C of the Income Tax Act. Partial redemption is not allowed during lock-in. Source: https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/jun-2017/categorization-and-rationalization-of-mutual-fund-schemes_34743.html

prompt: Can I redeem ELSS before 3 years?
completion: No. ELSS funds have a mandatory 3-year lock-in. Partial or full redemption is not allowed before the lock-in period ends. Source: https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/jun-2017/categorization-and-rationalization-of-mutual-fund-schemes_34743.html

prompt: What is the minimum SIP for SBI Bluechip Fund on Groww?
completion: Minimum SIP for SBI Bluechip Fund on Groww is ₹500 per month. Minimum lump sum is ₹5,000. Source: https://groww.in/mutual-funds/sbi-blue-chip-fund-direct-plan-growth

prompt: What is the minimum SIP for SBI Flexicap Fund?
completion: Minimum SIP for SBI Flexicap Fund on Groww is ₹500 per month. Minimum lump sum is ₹5,000. Source: https://groww.in/mutual-funds/sbi-magnum-multicap-fund-direct-plan-growth

prompt: What is the minimum SIP for SBI ELSS on Groww?
completion: Minimum SIP for SBI Long Term Equity Fund on Groww is ₹500 per month. Minimum lump sum is ₹500. Source: https://groww.in/mutual-funds/sbi-magnum-tax-gain-fund

prompt: What is the riskometer rating of SBI Bluechip Fund?
completion: SBI Bluechip Fund is rated Very High Risk on the SEBI riskometer. It invests in top 100 large-cap stocks. Source: https://www.sbimf.com/en-us/sbi-bluechip-fund

prompt: What is the risk rating of SBI Flexicap Fund?
completion: SBI Flexicap Fund is rated Very High Risk on the SEBI riskometer. It invests across large, mid and small-cap stocks. Source: https://www.sbimf.com/en-us/sbi-flexicap-fund

prompt: What is the riskometer of SBI ELSS?
completion: SBI Long Term Equity Fund (ELSS) is rated Very High Risk on the SEBI riskometer due to its 100% equity portfolio. Source: https://www.sbimf.com/en-us/sbi-long-term-equity-fund

prompt: What benchmark does SBI Bluechip Fund track?
completion: SBI Bluechip Fund benchmarks against the Nifty 100 TRI (Total Return Index). Source: https://www.sbimf.com/en-us/sbi-bluechip-fund

prompt: What is the benchmark index of SBI Flexicap Fund?
completion: SBI Flexicap Fund is benchmarked against the Nifty 500 TRI. Source: https://www.sbimf.com/en-us/sbi-flexicap-fund

prompt: Which index does SBI ELSS track?
completion: SBI Long Term Equity Fund benchmarks against the Nifty 500 TRI. Source: https://www.sbimf.com/en-us/sbi-long-term-equity-fund

prompt: How do I download capital gains statement on Groww?
completion: On Groww: Go to Profile → Reports → Capital Gains Statement. Select financial year and download PDF. Source: https://support.groww.in/hc/en-us/articles/360027553551

prompt: How to get CAS statement from CAMS?
completion: Visit CAMS online portal, go to Statements → Consolidated Account Statement, enter your PAN and registered email. Source: https://www.camsonline.com/Investors/Statements/Consolidated-Account-Statement

prompt: Where can I check NAV of SBI Bluechip Fund?
completion: NAV is declared daily by 11 PM IST. Check latest NAV on AMFI website or Groww scheme page. Source: https://www.amfiindia.com/nav-history-download

prompt: What is NAV and how often is it updated?
completion: NAV (Net Asset Value) is the price per unit of a mutual fund. For equity funds, NAV is declared daily by 11 PM IST. Source: https://www.amfiindia.com/nav-history-download

prompt: What is the difference between Direct and Regular plan?
completion: Direct Plans have no distributor commission and lower expense ratios than Regular Plans. On Groww you invest in Direct Plans by default. TER difference is typically 0.5-1% p.a. Source: https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/sep-2012/direct-plan-for-schemes-of-mutual-funds_25621.html

prompt: Is Groww Direct or Regular plan?
completion: Groww offers Direct Plans for mutual funds by default. Direct Plans have lower expense ratios than Regular Plans. Source: https://groww.in/mutual-funds/filter?amc=sbi

prompt: Where can I find SID for SBI Bluechip Fund?
completion: SID and KIM for SBI Bluechip Fund are available on the SBI MF official website under Downloads section. Source: https://www.sbimf.com/en-us/downloads

prompt: What is a KIM in mutual funds?
completion: KIM stands for Key Information Memorandum. It is a summary document containing key scheme details like objective, risk, costs, and loads. Available on SBI MF website. Source: https://www.sbimf.com/en-us/downloads

prompt: What is the minimum lump sum for SBI Bluechip Fund?
completion: Minimum lump sum investment in SBI Bluechip Fund is ₹5,000. Source: https://groww.in/mutual-funds/sbi-blue-chip-fund-direct-plan-growth

prompt: What is the minimum lump sum for SBI ELSS?
completion: Minimum lump sum investment in SBI Long Term Equity Fund (ELSS) is ₹500. Source: https://groww.in/mutual-funds/sbi-magnum-tax-gain-fund

prompt: Does SBI Bluechip Fund invest only in large cap stocks?
completion: Yes, SBI Bluechip Fund is a large-cap fund that invests minimum 80% in top 100 companies by market capitalization as per SEBI mandate. Source: https://www.sbimf.com/en-us/sbi-bluechip-fund

prompt: What type of fund is SBI Flexicap?
completion: SBI Flexicap Fund is a flexi-cap fund that invests across large-cap, mid-cap and small-cap stocks with no fixed allocation. Source: https://www.sbimf.com/en-us/sbi-flexicap-fund

prompt: Is ELSS eligible for tax deduction?
completion: Yes, investments in ELSS funds like SBI Long Term Equity Fund qualify for deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5 lakh per year. Source: https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/jun-2017/categorization-and-rationalization-of-mutual-fund-schemes_34743.html

prompt: How much tax can I save with ELSS?
completion: ELSS investments qualify for Section 80C deduction up to ₹1.5 lakh per year. This is a factual limit — actual tax saved depends on your tax slab. Consult a tax advisor for personal advice. Source: https://investor.sebi.gov.in

prompt: What is the TER update frequency for mutual funds?
completion: As per SEBI mandate, Total Expense Ratio (TER) is reviewed and updated monthly. Current TER is published on AMC website and AMFI. Source: https://www.amfiindia.com/nav-history-download

prompt: Can I do SIP in ELSS?
completion: Yes, you can do SIP in SBI Long Term Equity Fund (ELSS) with minimum ₹500 per month on Groww. Each SIP installment has its own 3-year lock-in. Source: https://groww.in/mutual-funds/sbi-magnum-tax-gain-fund

prompt: Does each ELSS SIP installment have separate lock-in?
completion: Yes, each SIP installment in ELSS has its own 3-year lock-in from the date of that installment. Source: https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/jun-2017/categorization-and-rationalization-of-mutual-fund-schemes_34743.html

prompt: How to download account statement from KFintech?
completion: Visit KFintech MF portal, go to Consolidated Account Statement section, enter PAN and registered email to download. Source: https://mfs.kfintech.com/investor/General/ConsolidatedAccountStatement

prompt: What is MF Central?
completion: MF Central is a joint platform by CAMS and KFintech for mutual fund services including statements, scheme documents and transactions. Source: https://mfcentral.com

prompt: What is the category of SBI Bluechip Fund as per SEBI?
completion: SBI Bluechip Fund is categorized as a Large Cap Fund as per SEBI's mutual fund categorisation circular of 2017. Source: https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/jun-2017/categorization-and-rationalization-of-mutual-fund-schemes_34743.html

prompt: What is the exit load of SBI ELSS after lock-in?
completion: After the mandatory 3-year lock-in period, SBI Long Term Equity Fund has no exit load on redemption. Source: https://www.sbimf.com/en-us/sbi-long-term-equity-fund

prompt: What is the full name of SBI ELSS fund?
completion: The full name is SBI Long Term Equity Fund. It is an Equity Linked Savings Scheme (ELSS) eligible for Section 80C tax benefit. Source: https://www.sbimf.com/en-us/sbi-long-term-equity-fund

prompt: Is SBI Flexicap Fund good?
completion: This assistant provides facts only and cannot give investment opinions. For scheme details refer to the official factsheet. Source: https://www.sbimf.com/en-us/downloads

prompt: Should I invest in SBI Bluechip or Flexicap?
completion: This assistant does not provide investment advice or fund comparisons. Please consult a SEBI-registered financial advisor. Source: https://investor.sebi.gov.in

prompt: Which SBI fund gives best returns?
completion: This assistant does not compute or compare returns. For official performance data refer to the SBI MF factsheet. Source: https://www.sbimf.com/en-us/downloads

prompt: What is the minimum investment in SBI Flexicap?
completion: Minimum SIP is ₹500/month and minimum lump sum is ₹5,000 for SBI Flexicap Fund on Groww. Source: https://groww.in/mutual-funds/sbi-magnum-multicap-fund-direct-plan-growth

prompt: How to check my SBI MF portfolio on Groww?
completion: On Groww: Go to Investments tab → Mutual Funds → You can see all your SBI MF holdings there. Source: https://support.groww.in/hc/en-us/articles/360027553551

prompt: What is AMFI?
completion: AMFI stands for Association of Mutual Funds in India. It is the industry body for mutual funds and publishes NAV, TER data and investor education resources. Source: https://www.amfiindia.com/mutual-fund

prompt: What does riskometer mean in mutual funds?
completion: Riskometer is a SEBI-mandated risk label for mutual fund schemes. It categorises risk as Low, Low to Moderate, Moderate, Moderately High, High or Very High. Source: https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/oct-2020/product-labeling-in-mutual-funds_48001.html

prompt: What is TRI in benchmark index?
completion: TRI stands for Total Return Index. It includes both price returns and dividend reinvestment, making it a more comprehensive benchmark than a plain price index. Source: https://www.sbimf.com/en-us/sbi-bluechip-fund

prompt: How to contact SBI Mutual Fund customer care?
completion: Contact SBI MF via their official website at sbimf.com under the Contact Us section. This assistant only provides factual scheme information. Source: https://www.sbimf.com/en-us/investor-services/terms

prompt: What is a flexi cap fund?
completion: A flexi-cap fund invests across large, mid and small-cap stocks with no fixed allocation limit per SEBI categorisation. SBI Flexicap Fund is an example. Source: https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/jun-2017/categorization-and-rationalization-of-mutual-fund-schemes_34743.html

prompt: Can I invest in SBI MF through Groww?
completion: Yes, SBI Mutual Fund schemes including Bluechip, Flexicap and ELSS are available to invest through Groww in Direct Plan. Source: https://groww.in/mutual-funds/filter?amc=sbi

prompt: Where can I find factsheet of SBI Bluechip Fund?
completion: Official factsheets for SBI Bluechip Fund are available on the SBI MF website under the Downloads section. Source: https://www.sbimf.com/en-us/downloads
